snippet.title: Knight George - SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Knight George is a part of SAGE 2025, with a brand new demo expanding upon last year's version! This video is a brief showcase of the content of this demo version.

Play one of the game's dungeon, the Ma'tava Temple, and participate in the Pentathlon at the Earlyne Olympiad: put your skill to the test in those five mini-games!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305040/Knight_George/
Download the demo: https://linky439.itch.io/knight-george
SAGE 2025 Booth: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/knight-george-sage-2025-demo.2655/
